Start date: 1140-11-07  
Add 40 weeks = 280 days.  
Add 2 more days = 282 days total.  

1140 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and 1140 mod 100 = 40 ≠ 0, so leap).  
Days from 1140-11-07 to 1140-12-31:  
Nov: 30 - 7 = 23 days  
Dec: 31 days → total 54 days.  

282 - 54 = 228 days remain into 1141.  
1141 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31 = total 212 days (Jan–Jul).  
228 - 212 = 16 days into August.  

Thus new date = 1141-08-16.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1141-08-16
